ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels distributed on outer lobes versus 55% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels concentrated in the central region and perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) occur along the entire continuous linear boundary, with increased amplitude and jaggedness near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight concavity before reaching the acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of scattered dark circular clusters (3-8 pixels in diameter) localized within the high-intensity white regions of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of parallel, diagonal low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation mapping on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel diagonal rake marks on the right lobe and irregular fraying/chipping at the outermost points of both fluke tips.
